cells.name: rust-ubuntu
cells.lint: cargo fmt --check clean; clippy ok (pre-existing style warnings)

oracle.role: pinned Microsoft C++ oracle; 7/7 upstream Python tests

python.role: Rust wheel + msrtc.rans package; 7/7 upstream Python tests

what_is_proved: The full Rust workspace test suite (131 active tests) passes inside dedicated Ubuntu 24.04, Fedora 40, and Alpine 3.20 (musl) containers — no host-side cargo
cargo fmt --check and clippy run inside the containers
The pinned C++ oracle and the Rust wheel are separately containerized
All containers run read-only filesystems, no-new-privileges, all capabilities dropped
scope_notes: The four oracle-dependent court tests are #[ignore]d inside the matrix cells; they run host-orchestrated, spawning isolated per-case oracle containers (never mounting the host Docker socket into test containers)
Run-scoped naming via docker compose --project-name msrtc-rans-rs-<run-id>
